name: Quesada (Spain)
description: Divided by a broad red band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and purple below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quesada (a castle and a cross with crossed keys on green).
history: Municipal flag of Quesada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
